description: Developing an autonomous, plain-English preventative health and telemetry digital twin for astronauts on deep-space missions. Combining interactive human body-system diagnostics, NASA HRP/OSDR physiological baselines, live solar radiation monitoring, and gamified crew readiness scoring to detect health anomalies early without requiring onboard medical expertise.
summary: ExoSomatic Health is an autonomous, plain-English preventative health and telemetry digital twin designed for astronauts on deep-space Artemis and Mars missions. On long-duration spaceflights, crew members face severe physiological hazards including space radiation, microgravity deconditioning, circadian drift, and isolation stress. ExoSomatic Health addresses this by gathering key health indicators (blood pressure, heart rate, sleep duration, mood, and radiation flux) and translating raw telemetry into actionable, color-coded self-evaluation insights. Featuring an interactive human body-system map, 180-day mission telemetry trends, and a hazard simulation engine, ExoSomatic Health empowers astronauts to catch health anomalies early and take preventative countermeasures without requiring on-board medical expertise.
details:
What it does & how it works: ExoSomatic Health simulates a 180-day deep-space mission telemetry stream, monitoring core human physiological indicators against NASA Human Research Program (HRP) risk thresholds. It features: (1) An interactive body-system diagnostic tab (Cardiovascular, Musculoskeletal, Neurological/Sleep, Immune/Radiation); (2) Dynamic time-series vitals charts with green/amber/red anomaly alerts; (3) A spaceflight hazard simulator (Solar Flare radiation spike, sleep deprivation, microgravity deconditioning); and (4) Plain-English self-exam guides and countermeasures.

Tools & Languages: Built purely in Python using Streamlit for a responsive mission-control UI, Plotly for interactive telemetry charts, and Pandas/NumPy for telemetry data modeling.

Note to Judges: If the Streamlit live app is in sleep mode, please click "Yes, get this app back up!" to wake it instantly, or review the complete source code and architecture on GitHub: [https://github.com/vermaansh0609-rgb/exosomatic-health/tree/main]
